book.name: Genesis
book.title: Genesis Mosesna Moamba Memba, Indhanana Pholmomba.

content: Noatindi Os Nowana.
Men Noatindiva os nowana. Noanamba men Sem, Ham, Yapet. Pueumbva hivranamba, wo Semtindi Hamtindi Yapettindi os phona.
Yapetnamba men ombolva Gomer, Makok, Matai, Yavan, Tupal, Mesek, Tiras. Pimba hetindimba os nengsm uv simbehumunilna nihilm.
Gomernamba men sespalva Askenasnind, Ripatnind, Tokamanind.
Yavannamba men sespalva Elisanind, Tasisnind, Kitnind, Dotannind.
Memba honamba wannindna eindhumunil, wo hevna moa, hevna petha os vungeinna di wanda, eva di ten wan hovra kuvundtholla.
Hamnamba men ombolva Kus, Isip, Lipia, Kenan. Pimba hetindimba os nengsm uv simbehumunilna nihilm.
Kusnamba men sespalva Sepanind, Havilanind, Saptanind, Ramanind, Saptekanind. Ramanindnamba men sespalva Sepanind, Detannind.
Wo Kusnamba mongova ombol lohna, nihilva Nimrot. Hengas kuwulva andralva wulluhunna, seilva sna indhanariniva mongova owai, lohnamoa.
Wo Nimrotva tatawonga lohvna, Yawe doara hev ona nongaihana avalna era. Wo daipotava henomba tatawongava lohvrava, indhanamba os ishumnivra, yimba os lohv, oi Nimrot, ten Yawe ona nongaihanam.
No pethava Nimrotva boasna vaohothonamba, Bapilon petha, wo deuvkembelva samblasambla vewol vena Bapilon, Erek, Akat, Kalne.
No petha Bapilonmba wuleihana, wo henga Asiria pethara avhoana, deuvkembelva os vewol vena Nineva, Rehopotir, Kala, Resen.
Kalava kotamendekli lohvna. Resen kembelva hovra lohvna Ninevara Kalara.
Isip mongova Hamnamba ombolva lohna, wo Isiptindiva men os nowana, Litiatindi, Anamtindi, Lehaptindi, Naptutindi,
Krittindi, Kaptortindi, Kaslutindi. Honamba Kaslutindiva eindhumunil lovahinvna Pilistianindna.
Wo Kenannamba yiveltowondva lohna, nihilva Saiton, mongova Het, wo pimba os sevriv Sitontindi, Hettindi.
Kenanmba simbel luhunvna Yepustindina, Amortindina, Girkastindina,
Hivitindina, Arkatindina, Sinitindina,
Avatindina, Semartindina, Hamattindina. Wo nomba Kenanna towandalva os geku vena no petharam no petharam. Venamba, petham lehra vetha.
Wo ehelva os Saitonda Gasara venamba, Gerarra, wo mongova ehelva Sotomra, Gomorara, Atmara, Sepoimra venamba, murapeta Lasara.
Doa Hamnamba men, hevna moa hevna petha hevna kembel, os himba avhoangana.
Doa Semba Yapetna etel lohmanana, wo himba simbel luhunna indkumbi Hiprunindm.
Semtindiva os nowana Elam, Asur, Apaksat, Lut, Aram. Wo pimba os seivilv Elamnind, Asurnind, Apaksatnind, Lutnind, Aramnind.
Wo Aramnamba men towandalva, Usnind, Hulnind, Geternind, Meseknind.
Wo Apaksatnamba ombolva Sela, wo Selamba mendekli venamba, ombol pola, nihilva Eper, wo noinda pimba osva nengsm uv, Epernind Semtindi av.
Epernamba sambla ombol Pelek, Yoktan. Wo Pelekva mendah avna, wo moang vungu ve notindilm notindilm. Wo noinda osva awona, Pelekm, osm uv, bukethav.
Wo Yoktantindimba men Almotatnind Selepnind, Hasamavetnind, Yeranind,
Hatoramnind, Usalnind, Diklanind,
Opalnind, Apimelnind, Sepanind,
Opirnind, Havilanind, Yopapnind. Yoktantindiva os phona,
wo ehelva os Yoktantindinamba avhoanganamba Mesa kembella Separ kembella, venamba, di olora ten okomba pholohvm.

Doa Semtindiva men hekav, wo hevna moa, hevna petha, hevna kembel, os himba avhoangana. Doa Noatindiva os nowana, Noana ombolva, hevna moa, hevna petha. Pueumbva hivranamba, indkumbi os bukethana, Noana ombolna sespal.
